caption_lead: Table 2: Fidelity of the three persistence layers against model-visible traces.
caption_tail: Traces are treated as ground truth and include every tool call with arguments and every tool result with body. The sidecar retains 2.45 percent of the trace payload, a shortfall of two orders of magnitude. Character counts are exact; no tokenizer is applied, so token-level fidelity is not reported. All counts are taken at the same cut point (2026-11-07T13:35:24 local, filtered on each row's ts).
